intro: Tasha is bold yet simple—a compact table with strong lines, sturdy build, and timeless design that makes small meals feel just as special.

features.title: All-solid wood charm
features.text: With a solid rubberwood top and base, Tasha brings authenticity and strength to your dining area—no veneers, just pure solid wood.

features.title: Bold, angled legs
features.text: The angular legs give this table a distinct, modern edge while providing exceptional stability and striking visual balance.

features.title: Extra-thick tabletop
features.text: A chunky 40mm tabletop gives a substantial feel and solid support—perfect for daily use and gatherings around hearty meals.

features.title: Less is more
features.text: Tasha’s clean and minimal design pairs beautifully with a range of décor styles—from earthy and rustic to sleek and modern.

features.title: Small-space ready
features.text: Perfect for apartments or intimate dining areas, the compact size makes it easy to fit into your space without feeling crowded.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
